query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dashboard_widget_layouts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  layoutName VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'default' NOT NULL,
  widgets JSON NOT NULL,
  isActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_widget_layouts_user (userId),
  INDEX idx_widget_layouts_active (isActive),
  INDEX idx_widget_layouts_user_active (userId, isActive)
);
